name: JEE Mains + Advanced 2026 — Comprehensive Batch
description: Complete 52-week JEE preparation program covering Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with weekly phase tests, major tests, and full syllabus mocks.

test_calendar.name: Phase Test 1 — Mechanics
test_calendar.syllabus: Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Work Energy Power

test_calendar.name: Phase Test 2 — Electrostatics & Organic Basics
test_calendar.syllabus: Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Hydrocarbons, Basic Organic Concepts

test_calendar.name: Phase Test 3 — Calculus & Chemical Bonding
test_calendar.syllabus: Differentiation, Integration, Chemical Bonding, Atomic Structure

test_calendar.name: Major Test 1 — First 8 Weeks
test_calendar.syllabus: Full Mechanics, Electrostatics, Organic Basics, Calculus Basics, Chemical Bonding

test_calendar.name: Phase Test 4 — Magnetism & Alcohols
test_calendar.syllabus: Magnetic Effects, EMI Basics, Alcohols & Ethers, Halogen Derivatives

test_calendar.name: Phase Test 5 — Coordinate Geometry & Equilibrium
test_calendar.syllabus: Circles, Parabola, Chemical Equilibrium, Ionic Equilibrium

test_calendar.name: Phase Test 6 — Waves & Aldehydes
test_calendar.syllabus: Oscillations, Waves, Aldehydes & Ketones, Carboxylic Acids

test_calendar.name: Major Test 2 — First 16 Weeks
test_calendar.syllabus: Full Electrodynamics, Organic Chemistry (Basics to Acids), Coordinate Geometry, Calculus

test_calendar.name: Phase Test 7 — Optics & Electrochemistry
test_calendar.syllabus: Ray Optics, Wave Optics, Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics

test_calendar.name: Phase Test 8 — 3D Geometry & p-block
test_calendar.syllabus: 3D Geometry, Vectors, p-block Elements, d-block Elements

test_calendar.name: Phase Test 9 — Modern Physics & Biomolecules
test_calendar.syllabus: Dual Nature, Atoms, Nuclei, Biomolecules, Polymers

test_calendar.name: Major Test 3 — Half Syllabus
test_calendar.syllabus: Full Physics except Semiconductors, Full Organic + Physical, Full Mathematics except Probability
